topic: Useful and harmful changes in materials
key_concepts: Some changes in materials are useful to the environment.
Some changes in materials are harmful to the environment.
Burning dried leaves, paper, tires, and plastics can pollute the air.
Throwing used oil and detergents into bodies of water pollutes water.
Dumping garbage on vacant land harms the environment.
Cutting down trees can harm the environment.
Tree planting is a useful change for the environment.
Composting biodegradable materials is useful to the environment.
Reusing bottles, containers, and paper reduces waste.
Recycling used bottles, tin cans, and rubber tires turns them into useful materials.
Repairing items instead of buying new ones reduces waste.
The 5Rs are reduce, reuse, recycle, repair, and rot.
